title: Juicy French Tuna Salad
description: A fresh midnight‑craving French salad featuring sous‑vide tuna, a tangy vinaigrette, and crisp garden vegetables for a low‑sodium, juicy delight.
instructions: Vacuum‑seal the tuna steak with ½ tsp salt and 1 Tbsp olive oil, and preheat the sous‑vide water bath to 54 °C (130 °F).
Seal tuna and cook sous‑vide for 45 minutes.
While tuna cooks, whisk Dijon mustard, white wine vinegar, lemon juice, and remaining olive oil in a small bowl to make a vinaigrette.

Remove tuna from the bag, pat dry, and heat a non‑stick skillet over high heat; sear tuna for 30 seconds per side to develop a crust.
Let it rest 5 minutes.
Slice tuna into 1‑inch cubes and set aside.
In a large bowl, toss arugula, spinach, cucumber, radish, and red onion with the vinaigrette and 1 Tbsp low‑sodium soy sauce.
Divide the dressed greens between 2 plates.
Arrange tuna cubes on top of the greens and sprinkle with chopped herbs.
Drizzle any remaining vinaigrette over the salad; season with extra salt to taste and serve immediately.
